description.zh:
配额申请的资源目录成员的阿里云账号（主账号）列表。

> 单次最多只支持为50个成员批量申请提升配额。关于资源目录的成员，请参见[ListAccounts](~~604207~~)。
description.en:
A list of Alibaba Cloud accounts of the members in the resource directory for which you want to request a quota increase.

> You can submit batch quota increase requests for a maximum of 50 members at a time. For more information about the members of a resource directory, see [ListAccounts](~~604207~~).

description.zh:
配额申请的值。

> - 根据[ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~)中目标配额的`TotalUsage`（配额用量）和`ApplicableRange`（配额项可申请范围）来设置配额申请值。
> - 配额申请由各云产品的技术支持进行审批。如果您想增加通过几率，请在配额申请时填写合理的申请数值和详尽的申请理由。
description.en:
The requested quota value.

> - Set this parameter based on the \`TotalUsage\` and \`ApplicableRange\` of the target quota in [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).
>
> - Quota applications are reviewed by the technical support of each Alibaba Cloud service. To increase the chance of your application being approved, specify a reasonable quota value and a detailed reason.

description.zh:
配额维度的Key。

> - N的取值范围取决于云产品支持的维度个数。
> - 当`ProductCode`为`ecs`、`ecs-spec`、`actiontrail`、`ess`等时，配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置。
description.en:
The key of the quota dimension.

> - The value of N depends on the number of dimensions that are supported by the Alibaba Cloud service.
>
> - If \`ProductCode\` is set to a value such as \`ecs\`, \`ecs-spec\`, \`actiontrail\`, or \`ess\`, you must specify both the key and value of the quota dimension.

description.zh:
配额维度的Value。

> - N的取值范围取决于云产品支持的维度个数。
> - 当`ProductCode`为`ecs`、`ecs-spec`、`actiontrail`、`ess`等时，配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置。
description.en:
The value of the quota dimension.

> - The value of N depends on the number of dimensions that are supported by the Alibaba Cloud service.
>
> - If \`ProductCode\` is set to a value such as \`ecs\`, \`ecs-spec\`, \`actiontrail\`, or \`ess\`, you must specify both the key and value of the quota dimension.

description.zh:
配额生效的UTC时间。该参数仅适用于权益配额（WhiteListLabel）。
 
>如果当前账号不选择生效时间，则默认为提交时间。
description.en:
The UTC time when the quota takes effect. This parameter applies only to privileges (WhiteListLabel).

> If you do not specify this parameter, the quota takes effect at the time of submission.

description.zh:
配额申请结果通知的语言。取值：

- zh（默认值）：中文。
- en：英文。
description.en:
The language of the notification for the application result. Valid values:

- zh (default): Chinese.

- en: English.

description.zh:
配额失效的UTC时间。该参数仅适用于权益配额（WhiteListLabel）。 

> 如果当前账号未选择失效时间，则失效时间为当前配额生效时间开始起99年。
description.en:
The UTC time when the quota expires. This parameter applies only to privileges (WhiteListLabel).

> If you do not specify this parameter, the quota expires 99 years after it takes effect.

description.zh:
配额申请结果是否发送通知。取值：

- 0（默认值）：否。
- 3：是。
description.en:
Specifies whether to send a notification for the application result. Valid values:

- 0 (default): No.

- 3: Yes.

description.zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

> 关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见[ListProducts](~~440555~~)中的`ProductCode`。
description.en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service.

> For more information, see the `ProductCode` parameter in [ListProducts](~~440555~~).

description.zh:
配额ID。

> 关于如何获取云产品的配额ID，请参见[ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~)中的`QuotaActionCode`。
description.en:
The quota ID.

> For more information, see the `QuotaActionCode` parameter in [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).

description.zh:
配额类型。取值：
- CommonQuota：通用配额。
- FlowControl：API速率配额。
- WhiteListLabel：权益配额。
description.en:
The quota category. Valid values:

- CommonQuota: general quota.

- FlowControl: API rate limit quota.

- WhiteListLabel: privilege.

description.zh:
配额申请的原因。

> 配额申请由各云服务的技术支持进行审批。如果您想增加通过几率，请在配额申请时填写合理的申请数值和详尽的申请理由。
description.en:
The reason for the quota application.

> Quota applications are reviewed by the technical support of each Alibaba Cloud service. To increase the chance of your application being approved, specify a reasonable quota value and a detailed reason.

title.zh: 通过配额模板批量申请成员配额

descriptions.zh:
### 使用限制
单次申请的配额项不超过10个。
descriptions.en:
### Limits

You can request a maximum of 10 quotas at a time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun quotas create-quota-applications-for-template --quota-category CommonQuota --product-code ecs-spec --quota-action-code ecs.g5.2xlarge --dimensions Value=cn-hangzhou Key=regionId --desire-value 12.0 --reason Scale_Out --notice-type 0 --env-language zh --effective-time 2021-01-19T09:25:56Z --expire-time 2021-01-20T09:25:56Z --aliyun-uids 1350483376110000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun quotas CreateQuotaApplicationsForTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --QuotaActionCode 'ecs.g5.2xlarge' --Dimensions.1.Value 'cn-hangzhou' --Dimensions.1.Key regionId --ProductCode 'ecs-spec' --EffectiveTime '2021-01-19T09:25:56Z' --QuotaCategory CommonQuota --NoticeType 0 --DesireValue '12.0' --ExpireTime '2021-01-20T09:25:56Z' --AliyunUids.1 1350483376110000 --Reason Scale_Out --EnvLanguage zh
